request.description: Orient recent point-in-time price and volume; preserve exact runtime measurements and their observation windows.

actions.internal_fixed_query: business operations segments products services customers risks

request.description: Orient the business model, risks and segment economics from available annual or interim operating reports. Prefer annual background and latest interim when available; source presence does not prove every fact was visible or answered.
Orient management commentary on operations and stated outlook from point-in-time complete meeting content; retain scope and availability gaps.
Orient recent issuer-specific developments in operations, customers, financing, regulation and products; limited retrieval is not absence.
Orient reported growth, margins, cash and capital structure from point-in-time financial facts; preserve period, unit and data gaps.

plan.analysis_prompt: Organize and weight source-backed supporting and counter evidence for the fixed six-calendar-month adjusted-share-price 2x Predictor. Distinguish real commercial adoption from narrative and expose uncertainty; do not calculate probabilities, classify the final answer, alter the four-way judgment, or generate the prediction.
